about: Privacy canary needles (SPEC 5.7 rule 10). Agent-side input fixtures carry a canary in every content field: text fields hold a marker that starts with marker_prefix (then _<agent>_<field>_<n>), and raw id fields (session ids, thread ids, agent ids) hold a UUID that starts with id_prefix. None of these bytes may ever appear in any output. tools/privacy/check.mjs searches for every needle below, case-insensitively, as raw bytes, UTF-16LE, UTF-16BE, hex and base64 (all 3 alignments, standard and URL-safe alphabets), in file names and file contents.
